model_annotation: The two plots illustrate the relationship between BLEU scores and two different hyperparameters, α and p, respectively. Both plots share the same y-axis, which represents BLEU scores on a linear scale ranging from 28.0 to 28.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The left plot shows BLEU scores as a function of α, which is plotted on the x-axis on a linear scale from 0.1 to 0.9, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The blue line with circular markers starts at (0.1, 28.0), rises to a peak at (0.5, 28.5), then declines to (0.9, 28.1). The right plot shows BLEU scores as a function of p, with the x-axis on a linear scale from 0.05 to 0.45, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The blue line with circular markers begins at (0.05, 28.3), increases to a peak at (0.15, 28.5), then decreases to (0.25, 28.4), rises slightly to (0.35, 28.45), and finally drops to (0.45, 28.4). Both plots use solid blue lines connecting circular markers to represent the data points.
